title: The Offer Letter
intro: You got an offer letter from a famous company. You are thrilled, until it asks for a payment.
Tap anything that looks odd to sniff it closer. Pin what is suspicious, clear what is harmless.
When you are sure, decide what to do.

subject.text: Offer letter: Software Trainee, $70,000 a year

p: To receive your laptop and joining kit, pay a

addr.label: A free-mail address
addr.lens: A big company's HR would write from the company's own domain, not a free mail address.
addr.why: Look at the address behind the name.

selected.label: Selected without applying
selected.lens: You never applied or took a test.
selected.why: A job offer out of nowhere is a warning sign.

noint.label: No interview at all
noint.why: A job with no interview is bait.

fee.label: A "refundable" fee for a kit
fee.lens: You must pay $190 to receive a laptop.
fee.why: Honest employers never ask you to pay to get a job or a kit.

link.label: A pay-and-confirm link
link.lens: The button leads to a payment page.
link.why: Never pay through an email link.

greet.label: "Dear Candidate"
greet.why: Vague greetings are common but not proof alone.

actions.label: Check the company's own careers page and call its real HR line

trap.title: Lumenara Tech · Joining
trap.ask: Pay $190 by card to confirm your joining and receive your kit.

block_report.line: Reported as phishing and deleted. The fake address was blocked.

verify.line: The company's real careers page said: "We never charge candidates." Case cracked.

ignore.line: You stayed safe. But the same scam is still landing on other people.

go_ahead.line: The $190 went to a stranger. No laptop and no job ever came.

what_if.go_ahead: Honest employers never charge for a kit or a job. Checking the careers page took a minute.
what_if.ignore: Reporting takes two taps and helps protect other people.
what_if.verify: Checking was smart. Reporting it as well helps protect other people.

golden_rule: No real employer asks you to pay for a job, a laptop or a kit. Check on the company's own site.

quick_check.q: A famous company's offer letter, from a free-mail address, asks you to pay $190 for a laptop kit. What do you do?

options.text: Do not pay. Check the company's careers page, and report the email

quick_check.explain: Never pay to get a job. A real company pays you.

hints.nudge: Who pays whom in a real job?

rows.v: Look on the company's own careers page
